chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Salamah ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, from Ibn Jabalah, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man forgets the adhan and the iqamah until he says the takbir. He said: “He should continue with his salat and not repeat.”

key_terms.الْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer made before salat
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةَ: the second call announcing the immediate commencement of salat
key_terms.يُكَبِّرَ: to pronounce the opening takbir of the salat

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets the adhan and iqamah until starting the salat, must he repeat the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgets the adhan and iqamah until beginning the salat with takbir. The Imam عليه السلام rules that he should continue his salat and does not need to repeat it, showing that the prayer remains valid despite this omission.
